The '''Selonian glaive''' was a heavy combat melee weapon developed by the [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Species/Legends|species]]. 

==Description==
Selonian glaives were [[Weapon/Legends|weapons]] and art, crafted by [[Selonian/Legends|Selonian]] [[Gender|women]] as a rite of passage. When one reached maturity, they were expected to personally collect the materials to create the [[Glaive/Legends|glaive]]:<ref name="Suns" /> a heavy<ref name="Core" /> [[Wood/Legends|wooden]] pole for the body and [[Selonian obsidian]] for the blade, hooks, and barbs.<ref name="Suns" /> The glaive weighed two [[Kilogram/Legends|kilograms]]<ref name="Core" /> and had a body length of typically two [[Meter/Legends|meters]].<ref name="Suns" /> The weapon could cost as little as 500 [[Credit chip/Legends|credits]]<ref name="Core" /> or as much as 1,200 credits.<ref name="Suns" />

==History==
During the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Era]], the [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Benton Kaldo]] employed Selonians as enforcers for his [[Kaldo's criminal empire|criminal empire]], who wielded Selonian glaives in their duties. The [[Human/Legends|Human]] male [[Zyne Kinahay]]<ref name="Core" /> carried a Selonian glaive, which he wielded skillfully, while traveling [[the galaxy]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|218|Kinahay, Zyne}}</ref> between around [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]].<ref name="ZyneYears">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'' states [[Zyne Kinahay]] has been absent from the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]] for over twenty [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Corellian Crisis]], which ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates to [[18 ABY/Legends|18 ABY]]. Therefore, Kinahay must have been gone at least by [[3 BBY/Legends|3 BBY]] and returned in 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]].</ref> Kinahay still carried the glaive when he returned to the [[Corellian system/Legends|Corellian system]]<ref name="Core" /> in 18 [['ABY-BBY' dating system/Legends|ABY]],<ref name="ZyneYears" /> after hearing about the [[Corellian Crisis|Hollowtown disaster]], an event that [[Fire|incinerated]] the citizens settled in the heart of [[Centerpoint Station]]. At some point, the Selonian female [[Magalak]] carried a Selonian glaive, with which she was proficient.<ref name="Core" />

==Behind the scenes==
Selonian glaives were first mentioned in ''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]'', a [[2003]] [[Roleplaying game|roleplaying]] sourcebook for [[Wizards of the Coast]]'s ''[[Star Wars Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Core" /> They later appeared in [[Tunnel Delving]],<ref name="Tunnel">{{FFG|book=Suns of Fortune|story=Tunnel Delving}}</ref> a modular encounter included in ''[[Suns of Fortune]]'', a<ref name="Suns" /> [[2014]]<ref name="Sights">{{FantasyFlightGames|url=en/news/2014/1/24/set-your-sights-on-corellia|text=Set Your Sights on Corellia|date=2014-01-24}}</ref> roleplaying sourcebook for [[Fantasy Flight Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]'' roleplaying game.<ref name="Suns" />
